status: v1.0 final selected scoring-function set integrated into desktop app
built_in_model_policy: Desktop app synchronized to the deployed scoring-function set using bundled local JSON models, retained cross-category negatives, and the Han Se-eum endocrine model selected by cross-regime validation.

post_g005_broad_category_state.single_seed_caveat: G003-G005 rows are bounded one-seed attempts; report as current evidence, not final proof.

notes: Built-in app scorers point to the deployed scoring-function set, including the Han Se-eum endocrine model selected after outperforming the uncapped GJC endocrine rebuild on both the drug-negative and broad final-category regimes.
The pesticide scorer remains tied to the dedicated Pesticides class and does not merge Agrochemical Information into the target definition.
Food Additives and Ingredients follow-up branches were screened, but none were promoted into the deployed scorer set.
Desktop scoring remains local-first so confidential molecular structures do not need to be submitted to a hosted service.
